parameters.name: DiskIds
parameters.description: The disk ID. The value is a JSON array that consists of up to 100 disk IDs. Separate the disk IDs with commas (,). Format: `["Disk ID1","Disk ID2"]`.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **30** to **100**. Default value: **30**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds describe-rc-disks --instance-id rc-dh2jf9n6j4s149260000 --disk-ids 'rcd-bp67acfmxazb4p0000_,_rcd-bp67acfmxazb4g0000_,_…_rcd-bp67acfmxazb4d0000' --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tag Value=testvalue1 Key=testkey1 --status All --disk-type data --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds DescribeRCDisks --region cn-hangzhou --Status All --DiskType data --DiskIds 'rcd-bp67acfmxazb4p0000_,_rcd-bp67acfmxazb4g0000_,_…_rcd-bp67acfmxazb4d0000' --Tag.1.Key testkey1 --PageSize 50 --InstanceId 'rc-dh2jf9n6j4s149260000' --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value testvalue1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
